## Critical Issues

**Line 17-19 (CRITICAL)** - Token storage in plain localStorage. No httpOnly cookies, no secure flags. XSS steals everything. Fix: Move tokens to httpOnly secure cookies server-side.

**Line 57-60 (CRITICAL)** - Storing plaintext passwords in localStorage. Never do this. Ever. "Remember me" should only save email, server handles session duration.

**Line 34 (CRITICAL)** - `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with user error messages. Classic XSS. Error from server gets rendered as HTML. Fix: Use `{error}` in text node.

**Line 127 (CRITICAL)** - `eval()` with user input. Direct code injection. Fix: Use proper analytics SDK or `window.trackSignup(formData.email)` without eval.

**Line 145 (CRITICAL)** - `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` rendering bio. User-controlled HTML = stored XSS. Fix: Sanitize with DOMPurify or render as text.

**Line 163 (HIGH)** - Client-side admin check from localStorage. Anyone can edit localStorage and set `role: 'admin'`. Fix: Server validates role on every admin request, not client.

**Line 154 (HIGH)** - GET request for password reset with email in URL params. Email logged in server logs, proxy logs, browser history. Fix: Use POST with body.

**Line 162 (HIGH)** - Password reset without authentication. Token in URL, no rate limiting visible. Fix: Require current password or email verification.

**Line 66 (HIGH)** - Unvalidated redirect via `response.data.redirectUrl`. Open redirect vulnerability. Fix: Whitelist allowed redirect paths.

**Line 187-188 (HIGH)** - No auth headers on admin requests. Token exists but not sent. Anyone can call these endpoints. Fix: Add Authorization header.

**Line 210 (HIGH)** - Token in query string for activity logging. Tokens shouldn't be in URLs. Fix: Use POST with body or header.

## Medium Issues

**Line 119-122** - No error handling on signup fetch. Network failures = undefined behavior.

**Line 38-44** - Client-side only validation. Server must validate too. Never trust client.
